summary: Cavite 4th District representative until the House expelled him on 2026-06-02 (265-14, per input notes). The member page lists seven principal-authored bills, including an absolute divorce bill and two bills abolishing VAT or electricity taxes. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Expelled 2026-06-02 for disorderly behavior under RA 6713 (per input file notes); expulsion is not evidence of ideology. Only a divorce bill and VAT bills were found; direction of the replacement revenue is unreviewed. Public statements were not assessed.
